    • search

      @Query("SELECT tv\nFROM ThresholdViolation tv\nJOIN tv.room r\nWHERE (:violationStatus IS NULL OR tv.violationStatus = :violationStatus)\n AND (:roomId IS NULL OR r.id = :roomId)\n AND (:departmentId IS NULL OR r.department.id = :departmentId)\n") List<ThresholdViolation> search(@Param("violationStatus") ViolationStatus violationStatus, @Param("roomId") Long roomId, @Param("departmentId") Long departmentId)

    • countWarningsByDepartmentAndMetric

      @Query("SELECT r.department.id AS departmentId,\n r.department.name AS departmentName,\n tv.metric AS metric,\n COUNT(tv) AS warningCount\nFROM ThresholdViolation tv\nJOIN tv.room r\nWHERE tv.violationStatus = :violationStatus\n AND r.active = true\n AND r.department IS NOT NULL\nGROUP BY r.department.id, r.department.name, tv.metric\n") List<ThresholdViolationRepository.DepartmentWarningCount> countWarningsByDepartmentAndMetric(@Param("violationStatus") ViolationStatus violationStatus)
